title: XForge Accessibility Identifier Proposal
description: Schema for .xforge/test/plans/<plan-id>/a11y-proposal.json — proposed accessibilityIdentifier edits, each requiring an explicit approval before `xforge test a11y --apply` writes it to product source.

plan_hash.description: Provenance only. Not a staleness gate: an identifier the plan no longer needs is a harmless extra line, whereas source that has moved is the real risk — which anchor_text guards.

element_line.description: 1-based line the element expression starts on — what a reviewer should read.

kind.description: Button, TextField, Text, … Containers are never proposed.

anchor_line.description: 1-based line the modifier is inserted after: where the element expression's brackets balance. Not the same as element_line for a multi-line element.

anchor_text.description: What anchor_line said when the proposal was written. --apply refuses when it no longer matches.

indent.description: Exact leading whitespace for the inserted line, taken from the element's existing modifier chain.

locator.description: The identifier the generated tests will look for.

affected_cases.description: Cases that fail by timeout until it exists.

intent.description: What the cases do with the locator — the requirement the site has to satisfy.

approved.description: Set true to have --apply write this entry. Nothing else opts in; there is no flag that applies everything.

basis.description: Why the site was suggested. `label-match` means a string matched, not that the element is correct.

candidates.description: Other unidentified elements in the candidate files, for a human to choose from.

note.description: Why nothing was suggested, or that the candidate list was capped.
